title: DatasetManifest
description: Manifest defining metadata, provenance, class definitions, and split integrity for an ML dataset collection.

manifest_id.description: Unique identifier for this dataset manifest instance.

dataset_version.description: Version string of the dataset release (e.g. '2018.v2').

schema_version.description: Version of the manifest schema specification.

source.description: Originating source, reference URL, or publisher of the dataset.

label_mapping.description: Mapping from stringified source labels to normalized target classes (or null for excluded labels).

class_definitions.description: Descriptive names for each normalized target class index (e.g. {'0': 'benign', '1': 'malicious'}).

sample_count.description: Total number of retained labeled samples documented in the manifest.

split_counts.description: Breakdown of retained sample counts across partition splits.

excluded_unlabeled_count.description: Optional count of excluded unlabeled/ambiguous samples from raw source data not included in sample_count or split_counts.

integrity_digest.description: Optional canonical SHA-256 digest of the manifest contents or dataset archive.

assumptions_and_limitations.description: Explicit assumptions, bias notes, or constraints regarding the dataset.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this manifest was generated.
